newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste to time-charter vessel from Veritas.
newsitem.headline: Neste to time-charter vessel from Veritas.

text.p: Finnish oil, chemicals and energy group Neste Oy said in a statement on Thursday it would time-charter on an unspecified long-term contract an 11,500 dead-weight-tonne vessel to ship petroleum products.

Neste said the vessel would be leased from Swedish shipping company Rederi Ab Veritas Tankers. Neste will receive early in 1999 the 140-metre long vessel, currently being built at the Jurong shipyard in Singapore.
The ship, which will fly the Swedish flag, would be used mainly to transport petroleum products in the Baltic Sea and will replace ageing tonnage, Neste said.
Veritas Tankers has an option on another similar vessel which Neste could time-charter or have built at the same terms, Neste said.
